recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-34298 unless a future work group decision changes the BiologicallyDerivedProduct boundary guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-34298 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested updates to BiologicallyDerivedProduct Scope and Usage plus Boundaries and Relationships. The accepted modification was to apply those narrative updates but not the three element-definition changes listed at the bottom of the tracker.
initial_application: The request was applied through HL7/fhir#1546, merged as 75a4d5c7de after commit 4ea992dd37 changed source/biologicallyderivedproduct/biologicallyderivedproduct-introduction.xml to add the biological-entity clinical-application scope, examples, and Medication/NutritionProduct/Device/Specimen/Substance boundary bullets.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini confirms BiologicallyDerivedProduct is an active OO normative resource. Later final issues refined the same boundaries: FHIR-36797 changed Medication wording to blood group specific, FHIR-36798 simplified the Specimen choice, FHIR-37979 refined Specimen and Substance wording, and FHIR-46604/FHIR-51842 updated NutritionProduct wording and removed a redundant separate Nutrition section.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already conveys the FHIR-34298-approved documentation content, and reapplying the original 2021 wording would undo later applied decisions.

related_jiras.note: Refined the seed's Medication boundary wording from within the same blood group to blood group specific.
Refined the seed's Specimen boundary by removing the transition wording.
Further refined the Specimen grammar and replaced the Substance donor-relationship sentence with batch/lot and manufacturing-record wording.
Refined the NutritionProduct boundary wording for R6 and human milk ambiguity.
Consolidated the NutritionProduct boundary, added therapeutic administration, and removed a redundant separate Nutrition section.
